prompt: Inspect the fixture input directory, simulate a verifier-gate wording edit, and compute the same candidate diff without modifying the source file.

initial_state.task_intent: Exercise a multi-step Document Ops commit path without mutating source files.

input_artifacts.description: Markdown workflow excerpt with a verifier-gate placeholder.

success_criteria: The fixture input directory is inspected before edit planning.
The simulated diff replaces the verifier-gate TODO with Evidence Packet reviewed before commit.
The computed candidate diff matches the simulated diff.
The Episode Journal records every committed step with evidence and verifier references.
failure_criteria: The action sequence skips the initial directory inspection.
The simulated and computed diffs disagree.
Any committed step lacks evidence or verifier output references.
